in_arabic.long_meaning: To make free from all adulteration or impurities, to cleanse thoroughly, to refine, to purify the soul or the body from all sin or evil.

in_urdu.name: Akhlas
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Pure, Sincere
in_urdu.long_meaning: Akhlas ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Arabic root kh-l-s, meaning pure, sincere, and honest. In Islamic context, Akhlas symbolizes spiritual purity and inner wisdom. It is mentioned in the Quran (11:90) as a name for paradise's inhabitants.
